captions.detailed: A 3D model of a cross-slide milling vise. It features a dark grey rectangular base plate equipped with two parallel guideways. A cross-slide table sits on top of these guideways, allowing lateral translation. Mounted on this table is the vise assembly itself, consisting of a fixed rear jaw, a movable front jaw sliding along a central track, and a handwheel connected to a lead screw for jaw adjustment. The guideways and jaw faces are highlighted in a contrasting light grey finish.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cross-slide milling vise. The assembly should feature a rectangular base, a cross-slide carriage that moves along the base's longitudinal axis via prismatic joints, and a milling vise mounted on the carriage with a movable jaw that translates perpendicular to the carriage's motion. Apply a dark grey finish to the main bodies and a light grey finish to the sliding guideways and jaw faces.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a fixed rectangular base. It defines a cross-slide carriage as a child link connected to the base via a prismatic joint representing the lateral axis. On top of this carriage, it mounts the main vise body. Finally, it defines a movable jaw as a second child link connected to the vise body via a perpendicular prismatic joint, utilizing boxes for the jaw blocks and cylinders for the adjustment screw and handwheel.
